## What's Changed

- **Private mode.** An eye with a line through it sits at the foot of the side panel, and the first
  switch in Settings → Playback opens Listening: while it is on, nothing about what you listen to
  is counted — no stats, no "Your week", no new taste for the mixes, no Discord card. Playback is
  unchanged, and what was already counted stays.
- **Discord says why it is quiet.** Settings → Discord shows that nothing you play is shown there
  while private mode is on, and its index row reads "Off by private mode".
